Ticket T-8006 (sensitive; Opus security review after): the board token leaves URLs. Today every board page reads the token from ?t=, puts it back into every link and fetch URL, and tools/watch-server.mjs (around line 209) accepts it from the query on every route; long-lived tokens in URLs leak through history, logs, Referer and proxies. The contract contracts/watch-s4-ops.json already says /api/* routes are header-only and t is accepted only on the HTML page load (deprecated boardTokenQuery). Implement exactly this design:
SERVER (tools/watch-server.mjs): (a) Accept the token from three places with constant-time compare: the x-watch-token header, a cookie named swarm_watch (parse the Cookie header strictly; ignore malformed), and the t query parameter ONLY on the HTML page routes (GET or HEAD of '/', '/project', '/run'). Every other route (all /api/*, /events, /job/*, /shot/*, /history.csv, /board, /api/snapshot, /open/run, /nav/*) ignores a query token entirely and requires the header or the cookie (a request whose only credential is ?t= gets 401). (b) When an HTML page route is loaded with a valid ?t=, respond with the page and Set-Cookie: swarm_watch=<token>; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Path=/ (add Secure when the request arrived over HTTPS, i.e. x-forwarded-proto https or the remote option is on). (c) Every HTML response gets Referrer-Policy: no-referrer and Cache-Control: no-store. (d) Owner routes (if present) keep their own header-only rule; do not loosen anything. (e) The URL the server prints/returns (url = http://127.0.0.1:port/?t=token around line 315) stays: it is the initial page load link. The /nav/* 302 to the board's own URL with its token is also an initial page load: keep it.
PAGES (board.js, project.js, project-live.js, run.js, app.js, nav.js, gallery-tab.js, run-drawer.js, and a shared helper in board-lib.js): add BoardLib.watchToken() that on first call reads t from location.search, stores it in sessionStorage key 'swarm-watch-token' (wrapped in try/catch), removes t from the address bar with history.replaceState (keep other params and the hash), and returns the stored token afterwards (empty string if none). Every page uses it instead of params.get('t'), sends x-watch-token on every fetch/EventSource where possible (EventSource cannot send headers: it relies on the cookie, so drop t from its URL), and NO link, fetch URL, image src or EventSource URL contains t= any more (links rely on the cookie). Check each script's load order in tools/watch-assets/*.html so BoardLib is available; if a page does not load board-lib.js, add the helper inline in that script instead.
REMOTE (tools/remote.mjs): localUrl must no longer put ?t= on internal calls to the local server; send the token in the x-watch-token header instead (all deps.get callers). boardUrl (the address shown to the owner and in the QR code) keeps ?t= because it is an initial page load.
TESTS in tests/watch-token-urls.test.mjs: start the real server on loopback as existing tests do (see tests/watch-server.test.mjs) and prove: every API route refuses a query-only token (401/403) and accepts the header and the cookie; the HTML page with ?t= sets the HttpOnly SameSite=Strict cookie, no-referrer and no-store; a static scan of every tools/watch-assets/*.js file finds no string building 't=' into a URL (regex over the source for [?&]t=' and 't=' + patterns) except the board-lib helper reading it; remote localUrl has no t=. Update existing tests in context only where they asserted the old query behavior, and list which in your notes.
Do NOT touch tools/swarm.mjs, the tools/swarm folder, package files, .github, or the owner-action modules. Run `node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test tests/watch-token-urls.test.mjs tests/watch-server.test.mjs tests/remote.test.mjs tests/watch-assets.test.mjs tests/board-live-chip.test.mjs` and `node tools/check-package.mjs`.
